<h1 id="greenlet---轻量级并发协程切换的基石">greenlet - 轻量级并发，协程切换的基石</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是greenlet">一、什么是greenlet？</h2>
<p><strong>greenlet</strong> 是一个用于在单个操作系统线程中实现伪并发的 Python 库。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>创建轻量级的微线程（greenlets），这些微线程可以在不进行上下文切换的情况下暂停和恢复。</li>
<li>手动控制协程的切换，提供了一种比生成器更强大的协作多任务处理方式。</li>
<li>构建高性能的并发应用程序，尤其是在I/O密集型任务中。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>greenlet</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web服务器和网络应用</strong>: 在需要处理大量并发连接但又不想承担操作系统线程开销的场景下，可以利用greenlet来管理多个网络请求的处理。</li>
<li><strong>爬虫和数据采集</strong>: 当需要同时抓取大量网页时，使用greenlet可以高效地调度并发的HTTP请求，提高抓取效率。</li>
<li><strong>游戏开发</strong>: 在游戏逻辑中，可以使用greenlet来处理并发的游戏事件或AI行为，而无需担心线程同步的复杂性。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install greenlet

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install greenlet -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>演示greenlet的基本创建和切换</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from greenlet import greenlet

# 定义一个在greenlet中运行的函数
def task_one():
    print("Task One: Starting")
    # 切换到另一个greenlet
    gr2.switch()
    print("Task One: Resumed and Finished")
    
def task_two():
    print("Task Two: Started")
    # 判断是否为第一个任务，如果是则再次切换
    if gr1.dead: # gr1.dead在此处会是True，因为它还未完全执行完
        print("Task Two: Error, Task One should still be alive.")
    gr1.switch() # 切换回gr1
    print("Task Two: Resumed and Finished")

# 创建两个greenlet
gr1 = greenlet(task_one)
gr2 = greenlet(task_two)

# 启动第一个greenlet
print("Main: Starting gr1 (Task One)")
gr1.switch() 
print("Main: After gr1 execution completed")

# 检查gr2是否已经执行过
if gr2.dead:
    print("Main: Task Two is already finished.")
else:
    print("Main: Task Two has not finished (or not started fully), but it's okay.")

</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20greenlet%20import%20greenlet%0A%0A%23%20%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E5%9C%A8greenlet%E4%B8%AD%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E7%9A%84%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%0Adef%20task_one%28%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Task%20One%3A%20Starting%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%88%87%E6%8D%A2%E5%88%B0%E5%8F%A6%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AAgreenlet%0A%20%20%20%20gr2.switch%28%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Task%20One%3A%20Resumed%20and%20Finished%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20%0Adef%20task_two%28%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Task%20Two%3A%20Started%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E4%B8%BA%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E4%BB%BB%E5%8A%A1%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E6%98%AF%E5%88%99%E5%86%8D%E6%AC%A1%E5%88%87%E6%8D%A2%0A%20%20%20%20if%20gr1.dead%3A%20%23%20gr1.dead%E5%9C%A8%E6%AD%A4%E5%A4%84%E4%BC%9A%E6%98%AFTrue%EF%BC%8C%E5%9B%A0%E4%B8%BA%E5%AE%83%E8%BF%98%E6%9C%AA%E5%AE%8C%E5%85%A8%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E5%AE%8C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28%22Task%20Two%3A%20Error%2C%20Task%20One%20should%20still%20be%20alive.%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20gr1.switch%28%29%20%23%20%E5%88%87%E6%8D%A2%E5%9B%9Egr1%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Task%20Two%3A%20Resumed%20and%20Finished%22%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%A4%E4%B8%AAgreenlet%0Agr1%20%3D%20greenlet%28task_one%29%0Agr2%20%3D%20greenlet%28task_two%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%90%AF%E5%8A%A8%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AAgreenlet%0Aprint%28%22Main%3A%20Starting%20gr1%20%28Task%20One%29%22%29%0Agr1.switch%28%29%20%0Aprint%28%22Main%3A%20After%20gr1%20execution%20completed%22%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5gr2%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E5%B7%B2%E7%BB%8F%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E8%BF%87%0Aif%20gr2.dead%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Main%3A%20Task%20Two%20is%20already%20finished.%22%29%0Aelse%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Main%3A%20Task%20Two%20has%20not%20finished%20%28or%20not%20started%20fully%29%2C%20but%20it's%20okay.%22%29%0A" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行这段代码，结果如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">Main: Starting gr1 (Task One)
Task One: Starting
Task Two: Started
Task One: Resumed and Finished
Main: After gr1 execution completed
Main: Task Two has not finished (or not started fully), but it's okay.
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.mermaid-online-editor.com/zh?code=flowchart%20TB%0A%20%20A%5B%22Main%20Program%20Start%22%5D%20--%3E%20B%7B%22Create%20gr1%20(task_one)%22%7D%0A%20%20B%20--%3E%20C%7B%22Create%20gr2%20(task_two)%22%7D%0A%20%20C%20--%3E%20D%5B%22Main%3AStarting%20gr1%22%5D%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20E%7B%22gr1.switch()%22%7D%0A%20%20E%20--%3E%20F%5B%22Task%20One%3AStarting%22%5D%0A%20%20F%20--%3E%20G%7B%22gr2.switch()%22%7D%0A%20%20G%20--%3E%20H%5B%22Task%20Two%3AStarted%22%5D%0A%20%20H%20--%3E%20I%7B%22if%20gr1.dead%22%7D%0A%20%20I%20--%20%22False%22%20--%3E%20J%5B%22gr1.switch()%22%5D%0A%20%20I%20--%20%22True%22%20--%3E%20K%5B%22Task%20Two%3AError%22%5D%0A%20%20K%20--%3E%20J%0A%20%20J%20--%3E%20L%5B%22Task%20One%3AResumed%20and%20Finished%22%5D%0A%20%20L%20--%3E%20M%5B%22Main%3AAfter%20gr1%20execution%22%5D%0A%20%20M%20--%3E%20N%7B%22if%20gr2.dead%22%7D%0A%20%20N%20--%20%22True%22%20--%3E%20O%5B%22Main%3ATask%20Two%20is%20finished%22%5D%0A%20%20N%20--%20%22False%22%20--%3E%20P%5B%22Main%3ATask%20Two%20not%20finished%22%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Mermaid在线编辑器</a> 绘制示例代码的流程图，结果如下：<br>
